title: Act: Add token-gated AdminApp with Round controls
summary: Admin client calls, TokenGate, AdminApp and hash route
description: Implement admin client functions taking a token, the TokenGate form, AdminApp round view and route selection by location.hash.
acceptance_criteria: Admin calls send the Bearer header
AdminApp renders gate until token set

steps.symbol: new: adminRequest, getAdminRound, openRound, closeRound, listRoundContributions
steps.action: Add adminRequest(token,path,init) adding header Authorization 'Bearer '+token to request; getAdminRound(token,id) GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/{id}?world=the-boys-room; openRound/closeRound POST .../{id}/open|close?world=the-boys-room; listRoundContributions(token,id) GET .../{id}/contributions?world=the-boys-room returning AdminContribution[] (Contribution plus prompt_hash)
steps.expected: Each call carries the Bearer header

steps.action: Export TokenGate({onToken,error}) form with <input type='password' aria-label='Admin token'> and button 'Enter'; calls onToken(value) on submit and renders error text when set

Export AdminApp with token state (memory only), roundId state initialised from getCurrentRound().id; when token is empty render TokenGate; else load getAdminRound and listRoundContributions, render heading with world 'the-boys-room', Round id/number/status, number inputs 'Duration (hours)' and 'Max contributions per player', buttons 'Open round' and 'Close round' calling openRound/closeRound then reloading, and a list named 'Contributions' of prompts; on ApiError 401 clear token and pass error 'Invalid token' to TokenGate
